AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Leftover Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Integrated Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
